text:
Liam (Eng): FYI I'm planning to be in Seoul for ~10 weeks (Aug 2 - Oct 11) to help family. Want to confirm WFH stipend, visa/permits, and whether payroll/tax changes apply.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks for flagging. Per policy, temporary remote up to 90 days is usually fine but 10 weeks is close. Need details: will you be working standard hours? Any local contractor/consulting?
Liam (Eng): Normal hours, will be online during overlap, no local clients. No consulting.
Yuna (Tax): Heads up: South Korea has specific thresholds. 10 weeks (~70 days) is usually below tax-residency, but employer could have withholding if it's considered local employment. We'll log, but low risk.
Sam (Payroll): For stipend options: (1) one-off expense for travel-related internet/hotspot, (2) prorated monthly WFH stipend through payroll (taxable). Which prefer?
Liam (Eng): Prefer payroll stipend to avoid extra expense forms.
Nina (People Ops): Ok. Sam can prorate across Aug/Sep payroll. Liam, please submit temporary address + dates via /forms/temp-remote and choose travel insurance preference.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Complete /forms/temp-remote within 48h or People Ops will follow up. :alarm_clock:
Priya (Manager): Approving from team side. Keep overlap calendars up to date so meetings still work.
Sam (Payroll): Note: If you choose payroll stipend, it will be added as taxable earnings for Aug and Sep. We need your temporary address for records.
Yuna (Tax): Also please keep travel itineraries and work logs. If you return later and have repeated visits, that could change risk profile. If another Redwood headcount is in Korea overlapping >30 days, escalate to tax@redwood.com.
Liam (Eng): I'll fill the form today and DM my flight/airbnb. I have Redwood travel insurance for emergencies — will rely on that.
Nina (People Ops): Two more items: (1) Confirm whether you'll use public healthcare — unlikely for short stay — and (2) do you plan to meet any customers in Seoul?
Liam (Eng): No customer meetings scheduled. Healthcare = travel insurance only.
Sam (Payroll): OK — action: Liam submits form; payroll to add prorated stipend entries (Aug/Sep). I'll post here once entries are in (expected by 2027-08-20 pay run).
peopleops-bot: Temp Remote Request logged (ID #TR-2027-199).
Yuna (Tax): Added internal note: "Seoul short-term stay, under 90 days, travel insurance, no clients". Keep receipts for internet/housing if asked.
Nina (People Ops): Marking this as "approved provisional". If dates extend beyond 90 days or you take a local role, re-open ticket.
Priya (Manager): Thanks Liam. Please sync with on-call rota changes if any.
Liam (Eng): Will do. Thanks everyone. :thanks_emoji:
Sam (Payroll): Posted: "Stipend scheduled: 2027-08-31 and 2027-09-30 payroll runs"
Nina (People Ops): Closing thread pending payroll confirmation.
peopleops-bot: Note: Please attach TR-2027-199 to Liam's people record when complete."
